subject: general
question:
Choose the correct tense to complete the sentence:

The policeman ______ the traffic when the accident happened.
solution:
The correct answer is "**was directing**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

We need to understand the type of sentence to know what tense to use.
